svg.text: AutoCurricula & GradeSync Engine — One Job, Seven Stages
Level 3: what enters and leaves each stage, which model it runs, where the checkpoint lands, and the exact place it is allowed to refuse. Timings are one measured 8-exam batch.
Trigger — OBJECT_FINALIZE on the batch prefix → Pub/Sub push → POST /webhooks/pubsub (OIDC, audience-pinned, plus a shared token)
All seven stages run inside that one HTTP request. The delivery is acknowledged only once the job record reaches completed — a failure anywhere below is a 5xx, and Pub/Sub retries it.

What a failure costs, and what the whole batch cost

Any stage that raises marks the job record failed, answers 5xx and leaves the delivery unacknowledged. Pub/Sub redelivers, and every stage already checkpointed replays from Firestore instead of re-running.
Measured on the SIS-outage scenario: first delivery 41.0 s, the two that resumed 2.3 s and 8.0 s. A duplicate delivery of a completed job answers duplicate — zero SIS writes, zero recompute.
One 8-exam batch end to end: 43.9 s wall clock · 40.2 s summed across the stages (the gap is the checkpoint writes) · 16 LLM calls · 45 028 in / 30 368 out tokens · $0.31275 = $0.0391 per exam
Stage timings, token counts and costs: docs/reports/e2e-2026-08-19.md (job e2e-2026-08-19-matematicas-10a-parcial1, trace 9c41e77b20f5a3d6). Legibility, armor and breaker figures: production run
